title: linux-admin expanded to 101 skills
summary: linux-admin now documents 101 expert skills, including minimal architecture, Linux source guarding, server memory, web stack security, chief engineer dispatch, and agent/model routing.
highlights: Added six new skills for architecture, source-change safety, server context memory, web stack security, Linux chief-engineer dispatch, and multi-model agent routing.
README, package metadata, plugin metadata, release notes, and website popup agree on version 1.17.73 and 101 skills.
README describes Codex as immediately usable through the AGENTS.md project-instruction workflow, with plugin-directory installation only when published or shared.
The server memory skill stores login flow and vault references only, not plaintext secrets.

Maintained portable agent support is documented in docs/AI_TOOL_SUPPORT.md for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Amazon Q Developer, Zed Agent, JetBrains Junie, Aider, Sourcegraph Cody, and goose.
